logline: When India's most beloved Bollywood actress vanishes without a trace, investigators peel back the glamorous facade of her life to uncover painful family secrets and hidden enemies.

renewal.note: One season of 8 episodes. Netflix India has not announced a second season and the miniseries format suggests a closed run.

bollymeter.basis: Madhuri Dixit-Nene carries the show on sheer screen presence, but a 50 percent Rotten Tomatoes score from 6 critics and a 6.6 IMDb rating reflect a series that works as a star showcase without cohering as a satisfying thriller.

pull_quotes.text: Dixit and the ensemble cast delivers pitch-perfect family drama.
What The Fame Game showcases is the depth and marvels of Dixit as she switches between star and human, mother and woman.

seasons.review_body: Netflix India debuted The Fame Game on 25 February 2022, directed by Bejoy Nambiar and Karishma Kohli. The critical consensus - split evenly at 50 percent on Rotten Tomatoes from six reviewers - was that the show worked best as family drama and struggled as a crime investigation. Madhuri Dixit-Nene's portrayal of superstar Anamika Anand drew near-universal praise, with Rediff noting her fluency in switching between public persona and private suffering. Sanjay Kapoor and Manav Kaul in supporting roles added weight to the family dysfunction at the story's centre. Audience scores at 6.6 on IMDb reflected appreciation for the lead performance but frustration with a mystery that telegraphed its reveals early.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 1
episode_reviews.review_body: The Fame Game Season 1 Episode 1 aired February 25, 2022 on Netflix as the premiere of the eight-episode series. Rotten Tomatoes holds the season at 50 percent from 6 critics; IMDb audiences scored it 6.6. Rediff noted the show demonstrates 'the depth and marvels of Dixit as she switches between star and human, mother and woman.' The premiere establishes Anamika Anand's glossy public life and her fraught private one with efficiency: Madhuri Dixit-Nene commands every frame, and the gap between the star she plays and the woman underneath is established through body language before a single line of dialogue about it is spoken. The episode sets up the disappearance mystery while using the fashion-and-film-industry setting to illustrate how completely Anamika's private self has been consumed by the public one. The mystery's first hour is more interested in atmosphere than procedural clarity.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 8
episode_reviews.review_body: The Fame Game Season 1 Episode 8 aired February 25, 2022 on Netflix as the series finale. Rotten Tomatoes holds the season at 50 percent from 6 critics; IMDb audiences scored it 6.6. India TV called the ensemble 'pitch-perfect family drama.' The finale resolves Anamika's disappearance in a manner that prioritises emotional catharsis over procedural rigour. Madhuri Dixit-Nene sustains the performance through the closing hour, but the mystery's resolution requires significant suspension of thriller logic. Viewers who invested in the family drama over the investigation mechanics will find more satisfaction here than those who expected a tightly plotted thriller payoff. The 50 percent split on Rotten Tomatoes tracks this divide in audience expectation precisely.
